fields.title: string

RepositoryClassification.description: Review queue row for a public repository outside the curated software catalog, including description-quality triage.

fields.name: string; repository name
fields.description: string; current GitHub description or empty
fields.description_quality: missing, short, or substantive; triage signal only
fields.catalog_role: not_curated, or acknowledged_not_curated for deliberate exclusions
fields.review_status: defer, acknowledged, accept, reject, or supersede
fields.acknowledged_reason: present when review_status is acknowledged; one of profile_repo, profile_infrastructure, test_repo, website, rename_duplicate, private_mirror, empty_repo, fork_not_curated (see data/repository-exclusions.json)
fields.reviewed_by: present when review_status is acknowledged; principal for an individual decision about this repository, standing_policy for a fork retired by an already-recorded principal decision
fields.reviewed_at: present when review_status is acknowledged; ISO calendar date the decision was recorded
fields.policy_source: present only when reviewed_by is standing_policy; names the principal decision that was applied. Its absence on a standing_policy row is a validation error, never a defaulted 'reviewed'
